subject: Urgent: convert onsite to remote — border processing delay
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@gmail.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Onsite confirmation — Tuesday 4/20 (two loops) — Redwood

Hi Diego,

Quick confirmation for your upcoming on-site loop for Senior Backend Engineer at Redwood:
- Date: Tue, Apr 20
- Location: Redwood SF office (or remote if needed)
- Schedule: 10:00–11:30 tech interviews, 12:30–1:00 hiring manager sync (Markus), 1:30–2:00 wrap + recruiting check-in

Please reply if anything changes with travel or if you need to switch to remote — we can accommodate same-day conversions but would need a heads-up.

Bring a government ID for check-in; let me know if you want me to send a printable visitor pass.

Thanks and looking forward to meeting you in person.

—
Marissa Cole
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0185

From: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 17:45:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite confirmation — Tuesday 4/20 (two loops) — Redwood

Marissa / Markus —

I'm unfortunately stuck at the border processing at the airport. They took my passport to verify a missing visa endorsement and told me it could take several hours to get stamped/returned. I was mid-transit and only found out after the line — I'm still in the same terminal but I won't make it back to the office in time.

Is it possible to convert Tuesday's on-site to remote? I can do the full slate over Zoom if we compress or reorder things (I can do back-to-back shorter sessions). I can also join from my phone/hotspot if that's the only option.

I really appreciate the team's flexibility — I wouldn't ask if it weren't unavoidable.

Attached: boarding pass is with my travel agent; I'll forward a scan of the consulate receipt once I have it.

Apologies for the scramble and thank you for bearing with me.

Best,
Diego Ramos
+1 (510) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@gmail.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 18:05:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite confirmation — Tuesday 4/20 (two loops) — Redwood

Diego —

Thanks for the update and for flagging this quickly. Yes — we can convert the loop to remote for Tuesday. Two quick asks so we can move fast:
1) Can you confirm the earliest time window you're reliable for on Tue (PDT)? Markus and Irene are willing to compress the interviews into a 90–120 minute contiguous block but need a confirmed window.
2) If you can, please attach a quick photo/scan of the consulate/immigration receipt and any boarding pass screenshot so security can note it for visitor logging.

We will:
- Reorder interviews so hiring manager sync happens immediately after the main loop (shorten to 20–25 mins)
- Share a single Zoom link; we'll ask interviewers to be ready to accept minor audio degradation (hotspot)

Markus / Irene — we can keep the same interviewer set but I will compact the schedule. Markus, are you OK with a compressed 11:00–12:45 window instead of the original timing? I can push the calendar and attach an updated invite.

—
Marissa

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 18:22:10 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite confirmation — Tuesday 4/20 (two loops) — Redwood

Marissa / Irene —

Yes, I can move my sync. Thank you Diego for the heads-up and Marissa for sorting this out.

Proposed compressed schedule (Tue, Apr 20, PDT):
- 11:00–12:20: Technical loop (three 25-miners with 5–10 min buffer)
- 12:25–12:45: Hiring manager sync (Markus)
- 12:45–1:00: Recruiting close (Marissa)

Irene — please confirm if you can join the technical loop at 11:00 instead of the earlier slot. If anyone else needs to drop, we can shift the first interviewer to 11:10 and compress slightly.

I'll let Marissa send the Zoom link and updated invite. Please make notes in Greenhouse with the schedule change and mark "remote due to travel delay" for auditing.

—
Markus Klein
Director of Eng, Inference Runtime
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@gmail.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Apr 2027 19:03:02 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite confirmation — Tuesday 4/20 (two loops) — Redwood

Diego —

Great — Markus confirmed. I've compressed the loop and created a single Zoom link. I uploaded the boarding pass and the consulate receipt you mentioned to our secure recruiting folder and attached the files here as well. I also pushed an updated calendar invite (see attached .ics and calendar link).

Attachments: boarding_pass_diego_ramos.pdf, consulate_receipt_0427.jpg, updated_schedule.ics
Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.com/event/8f3b-req1923-diego
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-recruiting-req1923

Notes for interviewers: please expect some audio variability; Diego indicated he can connect via mobile hotspot. Keep questions focused and, if screen-sharing is required for a coding exercise, allow Diego to use his GitHub Codespace or share a browser-based editor rather than forcing a local IDE.

If anything changes (passport returned earlier or further delay), Diego — please update us and we'll revert to on-site if possible.

—
Marissa Cole
Technical Recruiter, Redwood Inference

From: Diego Ramos <diego.ramos@gmail.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 20:10:09 -0700
Subject: Re: Onsite confirmation — Tuesday 4/20 (two loops) — Redwood

Marissa / Markus / Irene —

Thank you all for the quick accommodation. I got the consulate slip attached (forwarded via travel agent) and I will be ready for 11:00 PDT on Tue. I will join from my phone hotspot and will keep my camera on as much as possible.

A couple quick requests:
- For the coding round, can I use a shared Codeshare link (I will paste in chat) rather than screen-sharing my entire desktop?
- If any interviewer wants to see a code example I wrote, I can post a short gist or link to a repo ahead of time.

Again, apologies for the disruption — I hope to be in the office for the next stage if all goes well.

See you Tuesday at 11:00 PDT.

Best,
Diego
